title: In the shadow of the glen
html_source: Play by J.M Synge. Cranly’s statement that 12 Wicklow disciples could free Ireland is placed with WB Yeats and Synge’s literature ie the celtic revival.

anchor.text: In the shadow of the glen
anchor.prefix: klowmen to free their sireland. Gaptoothed Kathleen, her four beautiful green fields, the stranger 1961#184in her house. And one more to hail him: ave, rabbi: the Tinahely twelve.
anchor.suffix:
he cooees for them. My soul's youth I gave him, night by night. Godspeed. Good hunting. 

 Mulligan has my telegram. 

 Folly. Persist. 

 — Our young Irish bards, John Eglinton c
